sections.title: Crawl space sewage cleanup in Crowley beneath a fixed feature
sections.text: A fixed cabinet or other feature above the floor may make an overhead opening impractical while access below remains limited. We will identify the route available and explain any additional access proposed. The fixed feature will not be used as a reason to claim inaccessible material was treated.

sections.title: Address reachable components by their condition
sections.text: The plan will distinguish material proposed for removal from retained surfaces needing cleaning or evaluation. We will explain clearance limitations and any utility task requiring another provider. Newly accessible findings will be reviewed before the work boundary expands.

sections.title: Record what remains before reconstruction
sections.text: We will identify sections addressed and any unresolved source, moisture or access issue. The repair provider can then plan around the actual completed area. Replacement material should not close off a section still awaiting a defined cleanup step.
